  packaged-ui:
    name: Packaged PHP settings HTTP and browser
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    services:
      database:
        image: mariadb:10.11
        env:
          MARIADB_DATABASE: cwp_test
          MARIADB_USER: cwp_test
          MARIADB_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
          MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: synthetic-root-only
        ports: ['3306']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping --silent"
          --health-interval=5s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=20
    env:
      CWP_TEST_DATABASE: cwp_test
      CWP_TEST_HOST: 127.0.0.1
      CWP_TEST_USER: cwp_test
      CWP_TEST_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify current generated inventory and documentation
        run: |
          PYTHONPATH=tools python -B -c 'import build; build.generated(False)'
          python -B tools/check_docs.py
      - name: Prepare official isolated PHP and Chromium runtime
        run: docker build -t cwp-php-ui -f tests/php-controls-ui/Dockerfile tests/php-controls-ui
      - name: Build exact package and exercise real authenticated forms
        env:
          CWP_TEST_PORT: ${{ job.services.database.ports[3306] }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          docker run --rm --network host --shm-size=1g --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
            -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" \
            -e CWP_TEST_DATABASE -e CWP_TEST_HOST -e CWP_TEST_PORT -e CWP_TEST_USER -e CWP_TEST_PASSWORD \
            -e CWP_UI_COMMIT="$GITHUB_SHA" cwp-php-ui sh -ec '
              php -l tests/provider_php_controls_ui_fixture.php
              php -l tests/provider_php_controls_ui_connector.php
              python -B tools/build.py --commit "$CWP_UI_COMMIT" > qa/php-controls-ui-build.txt
              python -B tests/provider_php_controls_ui_guards.py > qa/php-controls-ui-guards.json
              python -B tests/provider_php_controls_ui_browser.py
            '
      - name: Preserve only closed PHP UI reports and captures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: php-controls-packaged-ui-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            qa/php-controls-ui-build.txt
            qa/php-controls-ui-guards.json
            qa/php-controls-ui/results.json
            qa/php-controls-ui/PHP-Controls-*.png
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Record exact fixture scope
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo 'Dedicated packaged owner/primary-client HTTP forms with disposable MariaDB, actual browser sessions, strict loopback TLS and genuine cooldowns. Available-option positives are typed synthetic inputs; production default remains unavailable. No real provider, charge, mail, deployment or release acceptance. Private raw logs, session data, config, CA keys and runtime are excluded from uploaded evidence. Screenshots require separate visual review.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
